name: Buying Friendship: Magram
summary: A concern over Magram strength leads you to offer carved totems at Magram Village. The gift may open a path to the clan as an ally.

sections.title: An Offer to Gorhak
sections.body: Someone concerned by the Magram's growing strength asks you to present a sack of totems to Gorhak, their quartermaster. The clan's village is growing, and its soldiers are growing bolder. Its strength worries the one who sends you, though the Magram might become allies.

sections.title: At the Village
sections.body: At Magram Village in Desolace, Gorhak takes the carved totems and sees that your offer has a purpose. He does not know what you seek from him or the clan. For now, he welcomes you as an outsider.

faq.q: Why am I bringing totems to the Magram?
faq.answer: Someone worried by the Magram's growing strength hopes the gift may earn their trust and make them potential allies.
Gorhak is the Magram quartermaster at Magram Village.

faq.q: Where do I bring the totems?
faq.answer: Bring the sack of carved totems to the Magram Quartermaster at Magram Village in Desolace.

faq.q: What does Gorhak think of the gift?
faq.answer: Gorhak recognizes that the gift comes with a purpose, but welcomes you to Magram Village all the same.

faq.q: Why are people worried about the Magram?
faq.answer: The Magram village is growing and its soldiers are becoming bolder, raising concern about the clan's strength.

attribution: In-game quest text: Buying Friendship: Magram
